title: The Wild Spire
author: Orsen Marchetti
blurb: Freya Delacroix, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
